about_short_description.short_description: Stepping Stones Center provides applied behavior analysis, and speech, language, and occupational therapy for children.

product.name: Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) Therapy
product.description: ABA therapy provides behavioral interventions for children with disabilities to improve skills and reduce challenging behaviors.

product.name: Speech Therapy
product.description: Speech therapy addresses speech, language, and communication difficulties in children with disabilities.

product.name: Occupational Therapy
product.description: Occupational therapy helps children with disabilities develop daily living, motor, and sensory processing skills.

product.name: Comprehensive Multidisciplinary Assessment
product.description: A week-long assessment involving specialists to evaluate a child's psychological, behavioral, speech, and occupational needs.

product.name: Initial Consultation Service
product.description: A preliminary meeting to discuss parental concerns, observe the child, and review existing reports without conducting an assessment.
